location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
location.rationale: OAuth client credentials must be deployed only in approved Australian regions to meet organizational residency and compliance requirements.

oauthclient.description: Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
oauthclient.rationale: The OAuth client determines which application can use the credential for authentication and access.

oauth_client_credential_id.description: Required. The ID to use for the OauthClientCredential, which becomes the final component of the resource name. This value should be 4-32 characters, and may contain the characters [a-z0-9-]. The prefix `gcp-` is reserved for use by Google, and may not be specified.
oauth_client_credential_id.rationale: This field is used to uniquely identify the OAuth credential resource.

disabled.description: Whether the OauthClientCredential is disabled. You cannot use a disabled OauthClientCredential.
disabled.rationale: Disabling unused or compromised credentials helps prevent unauthorized access.

display_name.description: A user-specified display name of the OauthClientCredential. Cannot exceed 32 characters.
display_name.rationale: This field is used only for readability and identification purposes.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project determines where the OAuth credential is created and which resources it can access.
